title: Laws of the canonical compact-support system comparison
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $P$, normalized coefficient-system model family $D$ and a compactification $c:X\to Z\to Y$. InvertibilityLaw asserts that the specified proper/open comparison $b$ is invertible on every normalized constructible input for every finite coefficient inclusion $E\le F$. Laws is the record extending this invertibility law by the mixed quotient-transition law and coefficient coherence law. The restricted natural isomorphism has forward arrow literally $b$ at every object. These are definitions of law records and the restricted isomorphism, with no assertion of their existence. Built from [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [def-sp-field-shriek-system-mixed], [def-sp-field-shriek-system-coherence].
